from ringbuffer import RingBuffer


def test_items_are_held_oldest_first():
    buffer = RingBuffer(3)
    buffer.append(1)

    assert buffer.items() == [1, 2]
    assert len(buffer) == 2


def test_append_overwrites_the_oldest_item():
    buffer = RingBuffer(3)
    buffer.append(1)
    buffer.append(2)
    buffer.append(3)
    buffer.append(4)
    assert buffer.items() == [2, 3, 4]
    assert len(buffer) == 3


def test_clear_empties_the_buffer():
    buffer = RingBuffer(2)
    buffer.append("a")
    buffer.clear()
    assert buffer.items() == []
    assert len(buffer) == 0


def test_wraps_repeatedly():

    for item in range(7):
        buffer.append(item)
    assert buffer.items() == [5, 6]
